headline: Executive order names English as the official language of the United States.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Trump, declares English the official language of the United States. The only information provided is the title, so details are not available here. Those details include any changes to how federal agencies offer services in other languages.

who_it_affects.how: Federal agencies would follow the order's language policy, though the specific requirements are not described in the information provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 1, 2025; no separate effective date was provided.
